notices.title: London's Violence Reduction Unit - Pan London Tertiary Service
notices.buyer: Mayor's Office For Policing And Crime

sections.label: 사업 내용
sections.text:
About the VRU
The London Violence Reduction Unit (VRU), hosted within the Mayor's Office for Policing and Crime (MOPAC), pioneers a partnership-based public health approach to tackling violence rooted in prevention and early intervention. Since 2019, the VRU has invested in over 550,000 targeted interventions for young people across London.
Project Background
The VRU takes a public health approach to violence reduction, recognising that prevention requires action at different stages. Primary prevention seeks to change the conditions that make violence more likely, strengthening protective factors before violence occurs. Secondary prevention responds when risk or violence is emerging, aiming to interrupt risk and prevent escalation. Tertiary prevention focuses on reducing the harm caused by violence, supporting recovery and reducing the likelihood of further violence. These approaches are complementary, forming part of a wider response to violence and exploitation.
Children and young people affected by violence and exploitation can experience complex and interconnected needs, alongside significant barriers to accessing support. These may include safeguarding concerns, trauma, mental health needs, housing instability, disrupted relationships and difficulties accessing education, employment and other opportunities. Tertiary provision is therefore essential to provide tailored, coordinated support that addresses immediate safeguarding concerns, helps young people recover and improve their circumstances, and reduces the risk of further harm.
The Violence and Exploitation Support Service (VESS) launched in June 2024 to provide specialist support to young people across London who have been affected by violence and exploitation. Management of the VESS contract transferred from the Mayor’s Office for Police and Crime (MOPAC) to the VRU in October 2025, with the contract due to expire in June 2027.
VESS has made an important contribution to the VRU’s wider approach to tertiary provision, reinforcing the value of trusted relationships between practitioners and young people, flexible and personalised support, and a multidisciplinary approach connecting young people to specialist services, including mental health, housing, education, employment and safeguarding. This experience, alongside the VRU’s established expertise in violence reduction and wider evidence base, provides a strong foundation for the development of the new Tertiary Service.
As VESS is due to end in June 2027, the VRU is commissioning a new Tertiary Service to provide specialist support to young people experiencing the highest levels of harm, vulnerability, violence and exploitation.
Description of the service
The London Violence Reduction Unit (VRU) will appoint a provider to deliver a pan-London Tertiary Service for young people aged 11–25 who are experiencing the highest levels of harm, vulnerability, violence and exploitation.
The VRU Tertiary Service forms part of the VRU’s wider public health approach to violence reduction. It is intended to provide specialist support to young people who are already affected by, or at significant risk of, serious violence and exploitation, where intensive and coordinated, intervention is required to address their needs and reduce the risk of further harm.
The Service will deliver intensive, relationship-based one-to-one support that responds to immediate safeguarding concerns and the wider factors contributing to violence, exploitation and vulnerability. Practitioners will build trusted relationships with young people who may have experienced significant trauma, have difficulty engaging with services or have developed distrust towards professionals.
Support will be tailored to each young person’s circumstances, needs, risks and aspirations. This includes responding to immediate concerns while addressing longer-term factors affecting safety, stability and wellbeing. The Provider will coordinate support across multiple areas of need and help young people access relevant specialist interventions and wider services.
The Provider will work collaboratively with statutory, voluntary and community sector partners to support identification and referral, coordinate interventions, address barriers to accessing support and strengthen pathways between the VRU’s wider tertiary provision and other relevant services.
The Service will operate within a consistent pan-London framework, supported by strong local integration and partnerships. The Provider will understand local systems and community contexts in which young people experience violence and exploitation, while ensuring that young people can access a consistent standard of support across London.
The service is expected to:
- Identify, engage and support young people aged 11-25 who are experiencing the highest levels of violence, exploitation, harm and vulnerability.
- Deliver intensive, relationship-based support through named practitioners who build trusted, consistent and sustained relationships with young people.
- Improve young people's safety, wellbeing, stability and resilience by addressing immediate safeguarding concerns and underlying drivers of harm.
- Provide tailored, needs-led interventions that respond to each young person's individual circumstances, strengths, risks, and aspirations.
- Support young people to access, navigate, and engage with relevant statutory, voluntary, and community services through advocacy and system navigation.
- Improve access to specialist support, including housing, education, training and employment, family support, mental health services, and other interventions relevant to need.
- Strengthen multi-agency partnerships, information sharing, and coordinated responses across local systems.
- Promote culturally competent, gender-responsive, and trauma-informed approaches that reflect young people's identities, experiences, and needs.
- Embed lived experience, cultural competence, reflective practice and trauma-informed principles throughout service delivery.
- Strengthen local safeguarding and violence reduction responses through the sharing of intelligence, learning, emerging risks and contextual safeguarding insights.
- Operate as a connected pan-London service that shares effective practice, learning and intelligence across borough boundaries.
- Support wider system improvement by informing more effective local and pan-London responses to violence and exploitation through learning from service delivery.
Target Audience
The Service is intended for London-based young people aged 11 to 25 who are most impacted by violence and exploitation.
Support young people who demonstrate indicators of:
- Established harm: Violence or exploitation is currently occurring or has occurred repeatedly.
- Entrenched circumstances: The young person is experiencing persistent violence or exploitation that has not been effectively addressed through existing services or previous interventions.
- Multiple and interconnected risks: Violence or exploitation is linked to factors such as housing instability, family circumstances, harmful peer influences, trauma, substance use, education, or involvement with the justice system.
- Escalating or significant contextual risk: The young person is exposed to harm through relationships, peer networks, locations, institutions, online spaces or wider environments that require specialist intervention and coordinated support. This risk may be increasing in frequency, severity or impact.
Examples of young people who may be appropriate for the Service include, but are not limited to:
- Young people with missing episodes linked to violence, exploitation or criminal activity.
- Young people who are being exploited into, or are actively involved with, harmful peer groups, gangs or organised criminal networks.
- Young people whose risks have persisted or escalated despite previous interventions or support arrangements.
- Young people demonstrating escalating patterns of offending, exploitation, vulnerability or harm.
- Young people experiencing violence and exploitation alongside housing insecurity, homelessness, family breakdown, trauma, poor mental health, neurodiversity, substance use or disengagement from education, training or employment.
Scope of Delivery
The Provider will deliver a pan-London Tertiary Service for young people aged 11–25 who are experiencing the highest levels of harm, vulnerability, violence and exploitation.
The Provider delivering the Service must demonstrate the following:
- Credible and effective youth work
- Advocacy and systems navigation
- Safeguarding and transitional safeguarding
- Multi-agency partnership working and local systems integration
- Specialist intervention and needs-led support
- Reflective practice, learning and service development
The Provider will demonstrate experience of working with young people affected by violence and exploitation who present with high levels of risk, harm and vulnerability. 
The Provider will deliver a clear organisational approach to engaging and supporting this cohort. They must evidence how their approach enables them to build trust, sustain long term engagement, and achieve positive outcomes in relation to safety, wellbeing, stability and reduced vulnerability to violence and exploitation. 
Practitioners must demonstrate credibility, authenticity, professional curiosity and appropriate boundaries, supported by training, supervision and ongoing workforce development. 
The service is expected to work closely with local authorities, criminal justice system, education providers, health services, community VCS organisations, and other VRU tertiary programmes.

notices.title: CSP27042 - Data broker (DPI)

sections.label: 사업 내용
sections.text:
Requirement
UK Shared Business Services (UK SBS), on behalf of the Department for Science, Innovation & Technology (DSIT), is undertaking market engagement to explore data broker services, or equivalent approaches, that enable authorised government users to lawfully access, retrieve, export and utilise relevant digital data for analytical, monitoring, research and capability-development purposes.
Introduction
DSIT is seeking to understand the market capability for providing lawful access to relevant digital data and associated metadata from a broad range of online sources.
For the purposes of this engagement, a data broker service is a provider that aggregates, licenses and supplies access to external digital data through interfaces, APIs, data feeds, exports or other delivery methods, enabling authorised users to access data at a level of granularity suitable for analysis, reporting, evaluation and capability development.
While social media platforms are a primary area of interest, DSIT is also interested in services covering wider digital information environments, including:
Search and discovery platforms
Generative AI systems
Online communities and forums
Digital publishing and web-based information sources
Emerging technologies and platforms
The Department is interested in understanding access to text, image, video, audio and other forms of digital content where such data can be lawfully provided and used.
The purpose of this market engagement is to understand:
Available suppliers and service models
Coverage, quality and granularity of data
Access and delivery methods
Legal, licensing and governance arrangements
Technical and integration capabilities
Indicative pricing models
Market limitations and constraints
This exercise is intended to inform future decision making and does not commit the Department to any procurement activity.
Background
DSIT has previously utilised data broker services and identified value in accessing digital data through a consolidated service model. Such data may support analytical, research, policy, operational and capability-development activities across government.
Future requirements may extend beyond social media data to include additional platforms, sources, languages and content modalities. The Department considers a data broker capability as an enabling service that may support future analytical tools and internally developed capabilities requiring access to sufficiently granular data.
Previous supplier demonstrations have highlighted a range of market approaches and informed areas requiring further exploration, including:
Data coverage and granularity
Access methods and APIs
Licensing and legal compliance
Data retention and governance arrangements
Service support models
Pricing structures
Access may be required by multiple authorised users under appropriate legal, security, governance and audit controls.
Scope
Initial demand is anticipated to support 5-10 users with an indicative budget of approximately £100,000 (term to be determined).
The Department seeks to understand services capable of providing lawful and appropriately licensed access to digital data, including:
Social media content and metadata
Open-source web data
Engagement and interaction data
Network and propagation indicators
Search and discovery-related information
Other relevant information-environment sources
Particular interest exists in access to sufficiently granular data, including post-level information and associated metadata where lawfully available. Services that only provide aggregated reports or summary outputs are of lesser interest.
The Department is also interested in how suppliers address developments in:
Generative AI
AI-powered search
Recommendation systems
Platform access restrictions
Information discovery and amplification mechanisms
Aims
The aim of this engagement is to determine whether affordable, proportionate and operationally suitable services exist that can support government access to relevant digital data in a lawful, secure and sustainable manner.
Specifically, the Department seeks to:
Validate user requirements for data access, coverage, granularity and delivery.
Understand supplier approaches to licensing, governance, security and compliance.
Explore service, support and pricing models.
Identify market standards, constraints and integration opportunities.
Assess whether future user needs could be met through individual or wider cross-government approaches.
Objectives
Data Coverage and Granularity
Understand:
Available platforms, sources and data types.
Coverage across text, image, video, audio and emerging modalities.
Availability of post-level, account-level, engagement and network data.
Available metadata and historical access.
Source-specific limitations and dependencies.
Access Methods and Usability
Understand:
Search, retrieval, filtering and export capabilities.
Availability through user interfaces, APIs, feeds, managed services or other mechanisms.
Support for analytical workflows and future capability development.
Integration, portability and interoperability options.
Analytical Utility
Understand:
How services support monitoring, research and analysis.
Availability of provenance, traceability and source context.
Quality-assurance processes applied to automated or enriched outputs.
Human oversight mechanisms.
Generative AI, Search and Discovery
Understand supplier capabilities relating to:
Generative AI systems.
AI-enabled and traditional search environments.
Recommendation and discovery platforms.
Online forums, websites and other information sources.
Associated licensing arrangements, technical constraints and limitations.
Governance, Security and Compliance
Understand supplier approaches to:
Lawful access and licensing compliance.
Data protection and privacy.
Data controllership and ownership.
Retention and deletion.
Security and auditability.
Accessibility and responsible use.
Suppliers should detail any relevant certifications, accreditations or assurance frameworks.
Service Management and Value
Understand:
Reporting arrangements.
Service performance monitoring.
Usage metrics and data-quality reporting.
Support and onboarding provisions.
Change management and transition arrangements.
Commercial models and value-for-money considerations.
Supplier Response Guidance
Suppliers are not expected to submit detailed technical or commercial proposals at this stage.
Responses should focus on:
Data sources, coverage and granularity.
Access and delivery methods.
Licensing and governance arrangements.
Integration capabilities.
Support and service-management approaches.
Indicative pricing models.
Key limitations, dependencies and risks.
Information gathered through this engagement may be used to inform any future procurement specification, evaluation criteria, reporting requirements and assurance arrangements.
Indicative Market Engagement Approach
This activity does not commit the Department to purchase a service. Any future procurement, including an indicative contract duration of three years (1+1+1), user numbers, budget, technical requirements and assurance conditions, would be confirmed following market engagement and the relevant commercial, legal, data protection, security and digital approval processes.

notices.title: Equipment - The Paddocks

sections.label: 사업 내용
sections.text:
This capital procurement project represents a strategic investment in the health, fitness, and modern infrastructure of the council's leisure portfolio. It focuses specifically on the targeted acquisition of equipment assets across two distinct work streams
1. The Paddocks (Lot 1): A completely new fitness installation requiring standard premium cardio and fixed resistance equipment (Lot 1) 
2. The Paddocks (Lot 2): Deployment of fully automated, advanced digital strength and diagnostic equipment featuring real-time data streaming and NHS reporting integration. The infrastructure demands high-durability hardware capable of supporting automated user tracking, data-driven facility management, and direct synchronisation with exercise referral clinical metrics. (Lot 2) 
3. Runnymede Leisure Centre (Lot 1): Cardiovascular replacement consisting strictly of premium cardiovascular equipment upgrades. (Lot 1) 
4. The Paddocks (Lot 3): A dedicated suite of power-assisted, continuous motion exercise machines equipped with digital cloud connectivity software. This equipment is specifically engineered for inclusive rehabilitation, active aging, community health referral pathways, and users with limited mobility or long-term health conditions. (Lot 3)
The existing assets at Runnymede Leisure Centre have reached the end of their operational lifespan, resulting in increased maintenance overheads and a decline in user experience. Simultaneously, the development at The Paddocks requires a highly sophisticated setup to attract and retain members while supporting targeted health and physical progression initiatives.
Rather than relying on legacy hardware configurations or static, unmonitored equipment, the Authority is prioritising a forward-thinking, data-driven approach to gym management. By introducing automated biometric tracking and high-precision physical diagnostics alongside premium traditional fitness lines, the council aims to drive member engagement, reduce member attrition, and optimise overall facility performance.
Options Appraisal
1. Continued Maintenance of Legacy Hardware: Rejected. Continuing to repair out-of-warranty machinery or relocating aging equipment to new sites is financially non-viable. It fails to meet modern public expectations, incurs high ad-hoc maintenance costs, and does not provide the tracking capabilities required for contemporary data-driven health strategies.
2. Unified Multi-Vendor Bulk Purchase: Rejected. Attempting to bundle specialised digital diagnostic ecosystems and standard mechanical gym equipment into a single, generic lot restricts competitive bidding. It prevents the Authority from strictly specifying the unique software integrations required for real-time strength progression tracking and cloud-based user diagnostics.
3. Split-Lot Framework Procurement (Preferred Framework): The procurement is divided into three distinct, specialised Lots. This strategy allows the Authority to independently evaluate best-in-class manufacturers for traditional cardiovascular and mechanical resistance machinery (Lot 1) while establishing exact technical criteria to secure a highly specialised, closed-loop digital strength circuit and automated onboarding ecosystem that links in with NHS (Lot 2).
4.  Acquire a state-of-the-art power-assisted, digitally connected physical therapy and active health circuit designed for inclusive access, rehabilitation, and active aging (Lot 3)

notices.title: CEFAS26-06 Contract for an inspection-class Remotely Operated Vehicle with fibre-optic capability for seabed imagery research
notices.buyer: Centre for Environment, Fisheries and Aquaculture Science

sections.label: 사업 내용
sections.text:
Cefas requires one complete, fibre-optic-capable, inspection-class ROV system, depth rated to 300m, built on open-source or open-architecture hardware and software. The system will be operated from Research Vessel Cefas Endeavour and will:
• Collect high-definition, quantitative video and imagery of the seabed, including over rugged and complex terrain, using automatic depth / altitude holding, heading and altitude control.
• Integrate a survey-grade subsea imaging system (i.e. inclusive of water corrected optics and enhanced capture controls) or computational / machine vision-based subsea imaging system (i.e. with onboard image processing and controlled illumination) with independent digital video recording (DVR) and media management system, to provide continuity and interoperability with Cefas BAU seabed imaging systems and specific scientific programme requirements.
• Provide an open, documented and expandable platform for integrating additional third-party sensors (for example stereo cameras, lasers, sonar and positioning systems) without dependence on a single supplier.
• Be maintainable by Cefas engineering staff, with no recurring licence or subscription costs needed to operate the system.
The Supplier will supply, integrate, factory test, deliver, commission and provide training for the ROV system.
•The system will be a commercially available, production-level inspection-class ROV system (not a one-off prototype), with evidence of comparable systems in operational use and with off the shelf fibre-optic multiplexing designed for high bandwidth imaging sensors.
•The system will be surface-powered.
•All subsea components, including the vehicle, multiplexor, tether, connectors, camera, lights and sensors, will be rated to an operational depth of 300m .
•The system will use open-source or open-architecture vehicle control and telemetry, with documented interfaces, and will not rely on proprietary, locked or subscription-based software or hardware to operate, maintain or integrate third-party sensors.
•The system will support fibre-optic telemetry. The vehicle will also have capability to operate on a copper tether, giving flexibility across vessel and deployment configurations.
•The system will be deployable and recoverable from RV Cefas Endeavour by hand or with the vessel's existing deck cranes or A-frame, without a dedicated launch and recovery system or tether management system (TMS).
•The system will be suitable for continuous offshore use in a marine environment (temperature, humidity, salt spray, vibration and vessel motion) and will be supplied in rugged, transportable cases.
•All electrical and mechanical components will be supplied new, with a warranty of at least 12 months starting from the date of successful Site Acceptance Testing.
•Full wiring diagrams, interface control documents and parts lists will be provided, so that Cefas engineers can carry out first-line maintenance and fault-finding. Systems that non-specialist engineers can easily maintain, using off-the-shelf spares, are preferred.

notices.title: Portsmouth International Port - Repairs & Maintenance Support Staff and Ancillary Services 2026

sections.label: 사업 내용
sections.text:
AWARD & STANDSTILL PERIOD
Following receipt of tenders on 15th October 2026 the Council has concluded the assessment process and issued assessment summaries to the successful and unsuccessful suppliers as required under Section 50 of the Procurement Act 23 (the 'Act').
The Council reserves the right to amend (extend) the Standstill Period if needed; if this right is exercised, the Contract Award Notice will be updated and affected suppliers will be notified accordingly.
After the Standstill Period has expired, and provided no legal challenge has been made by the end of the Standstill Period or any agreed extension, the Council intends to enter into contracts with the Successful Supplier. Following this, the Council also intends to publish a Contract Details Notice.
Description
Portsmouth City Council has completed the evaluation of tenders for the provision of repairs and maintenance services across at Portsmouth International Port ("the Port").
The contract is expected to have an annual value in the region of £400,000 to £450,000. The contract will be awarded for an initial term of three (3) years, with the option to extend for up to a further two (2) years, up to a maximum total contract term of five (5) years.
The scope of the service includes the provision of a dedicated on-site maintenance team to undertake planned, minor, and corrective maintenance activities across the Port estate, together with the provision of gas safety inspections, planned gas maintenance, reactive repairs and an out-of-hours emergency call-out service. The Contractor may also be required to provide quotations for additional works and specialist trades as required. This procurement represents a re-procurement of the Council's existing repairs and maintenance service provision.
Background information
Portsmouth International Port
The Port is wholly owned by the Council and is the UK's largest municipal port. The Port is a major UK port, responsible for handling millions of passengers and vital cargo across the globe. With easy access from the motorway and major shipping lanes, the Port is ideally placed for ferries, cruise, and freight. 
Within Portsmouth Cruise and Ferry Port, referred to as the port, there are five Roll On/Roll Off berths serving both ferries and cruise ships. The ferries provide regular sailings to France, Spain, and the Channel Islands; the cruise ships attend the port with both full turnaround and cruise calls. Within the year of 2025, the Port welcomed 1.6 million cruise and ferry passengers, 570,000 passenger vehicles, and 190,000 fright units. 
The port usually operates during the hours of 0530 to midnight, 7 days a week, 52 weeks of the year. It has bold environmental ambitions to tackle its emissions and carbon footprint and aims to reach carbon zero by 2050. The Port's plans to improve air quality and their carbon footprint can be found under Sustainability and innovation on the Port's website at Sustainability and innovation - Portsmouth Port (portsmouth-port.co.uk). 
Further information about the port, including an overview of the facilities, current ferry and cruise schedules, cargo and logistics, etc, can be freely accessed on the Port's website via the weblink Home - Portsmouth Port (portsmouth-port.co.uk) 
The port manages The Camber, which is set close to the harbour entrance and is Portsmouth's oldest commercial docks, comprising of four berths that are available for small vessels that are primarily local fishing boats, small coastal commercial vessels, and private pleasure craft. The Port is also responsible for a significant area of the land in this area. Further information can be found on the Port's website at The Camber - Portsmouth Port (portsmouthport.co.uk).
Future Requirements - Core Team
The successful contractor is to supply a permanent core team of staff to supplement the Port's own directly employed Technical Services Group who carry out repairs and maintenance across the Port's estate. Both teams are directed by the Port's directly employed Maintenance and Facilities Manager to undertake planned, minor, and corrective maintenance.
One member of the core team of staff should act as a working supervisor having a good understanding of the Port's requirement and undertaking day to day liaison with the Port's Maintenance and Facilities Manager.
The core team are on site at the Port between Monday - Friday (excluding bank holidays), between the hours 8:00 - 17:00. Due to the operational requirements and security at the Port consistency of staffing is required and members of the permanent core team of staff should be treated as a dedicated resource. 
To cater for the dynamic work requirements, it is envisaged that the contractors' staff will be required to carry out a range of different jobs, which includes a range of trades (this is not an exhaustive list): 
•	Carpentry 
•	Plumbing 
•	Decorations / Painting 
•	Groundwork 
•	Horticultural 
On occasion the Contractor may be requested by the Port's Maintenance and Facilities Manager to provide a fixed quotation for a particular job or to provide additional trades outside of those listed above.
The Contractor will provide a call out facility to make safe, prevent further damage to property or personnel and to safeguard the public within a maximum of two hours 
Commercial Gas Services
The Contractor is to provide and manage an effective programme for annual safety inspections that ensures that all the Port's assets have Gas Safety Certificates that are less than twelve months old.
The Contractor is to provide a reactive responsive repairs service, which includes outside of the hours of 0800 to 1700 hours Monday to Friday.
The Contractor will carry out the right repairs first time as and when required to maintain the Port's assets.
Contract Scaling
The Port is a dynamic environment and though not guaranteed, may require the contractors to be able to scale up their workforce by up to two thirds of the current core team over the life of the contract, either on a flexible temporary or long-term basis which will impact the value of the contract which is included in the financial range included in section 8 on this invitation to tender.
Scope and Specification 
The Council requires the provision of Repairs and Maintenance Services across Portsmouth International Port, including Portsmouth Cruise and Ferry Port, The Camber and the Border Control Post. The services will support the ongoing operation, safety and maintenance of the Port's estate and associated assets.  
The principal elements of the service include:
•	Planned maintenance activities.
•	Minor and corrective maintenance repairs.
•	Provision of a dedicated on-site core maintenance team.
•	Gas safety inspections, servicing and maintenance.
•	Out-of-hours emergency call-out services.
•	Provision of additional specialist trades and quoted works as required.
The Contractor will be expected to work collaboratively with the Port's directly employed maintenance personnel and deliver the services in a manner that supports the operational, safety and security requirements of the Port environment.
This section provides a summary of the Council's requirements only. Contractors must review the Scope document in full, together with all associated tender documentation, as their tender response will be evaluated against the complete requirements set out within those documents.
Social Value
The Council are committed to continuously reviewing and improving the approach to social value delivery, and Contractors can find further information using the following link - 
https://www.portsmouth.gov.uk/services/council-and-democracy/social-value/
Impact of Local Government Reform 
Local Government Review 
As part of the wider Local Government Review (LGR), Portsmouth City Council has been required to work with neighbouring authorities to support the development of future local government structures and governance arrangements. The UK Government has now confirmed its decision regarding Local Government Reorganisation across Hampshire and the Isle of Wight.
Under the confirmed proposals, Portsmouth City Council will become part of a new unitary authority covering the areas of Portsmouth, Gosport, Fareham and Havant, together with Newlands, Horndean, Clanfield and Rowlands Castle. The new authority is expected to assume responsibility for local authority services from 1 April 2028.
Portsmouth International Port is a distinct operational asset owned and managed by Portsmouth City Council. Whilst responsibility for the Port may transfer to the successor authority as part of the reorganisation, the Council does not currently anticipate that Local Government Reorganisation will result in any material change to the scope, demand profile, operational requirements or estimated value of this contract.
Contractors should therefore prepare their submissions on the basis of the requirements set out within the Contract Documents. The Council's current expectation is that the services will continue to be delivered substantially in accordance with the Scope throughout the contract term, subject to normal operational variations and contract management requirements.
To ensure continuity of service and effective contract management, the contract may include provisions enabling the transfer (novation) of the contract to any successor authority and to accommodate reasonable organisational or governance changes arising from Local Government Reorganisation. Any such changes would be implemented in accordance with the terms of the Contract and applicable procurement legislation.
In line with established public sector contracting practice, and to ensure long-term resilience and continuity, the contract includes proportionate flexibility provisions. These are included as standard safeguards to ensure the contract remains effective over time, rather than to anticipate any specific future change. Such provisions may include:
•	The ability to make minor or reasonable adjustments to service scope or service volumes, where operational requirements evolve
•	Flexibility to reflect changes in organisational structures or governance arrangements, should these arise
•	Provision for the transfer (novation) of the contract to a successor authority, if required as part of any future reorganisation
Contract value and duration
The current annual contract value is estimated to be in the region of £400,000 to £450,000 per annum. This reflects the Council's current requirements for the provision of repairs and maintenance services, including the dedicated core maintenance team and associated gas maintenance services.
Based on the Council's current requirements, the Contract will be awarded for an initial term of three (3) years, with the option for the Council to extend the Contract by up to a further two (2) years, in increments determined at the Council's discretion, to a maximum total Contract term of five (5) years. The anticipated value of the Contract is estimated to be between £2,000,000 and £2,250,000 over the full Contract term.
The Council has included a maximum potential contract value of £4,500,000. This additional value has been included to provide flexibility should operational requirements increase during the life of the contract, including the potential need for additional resources, increased service volumes, or expansion of the contractor's dedicated workforce. Whilst the scope of the services is not currently expected to materially change, the volume of services required may increase over time. No guarantee is given that this additional expenditure will arise. 
The contract value range therefore reflects:
•	Core maintenance services.
•	Gas maintenance services.
•	Inflationary adjustments.
•	Potential increases in service volumes and workforce requirements over time.
The upper contract value represents the maximum potential value of the contract and should not be interpreted as a commitment or guarantee of expenditure by the Council.

notices.title: Finland – Software package and information systems – Perehdytysjärjestelmän ja oppimisjärjestelmän kokonaisratkaisu

sections.label: 사업 내용
sections.text: Hankinnan kohteena on Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueen käyttöön hankittava perehdytysjärjestelmän ja oppimisjärjestelmän muodostama kokonaisratkaisu siihen liittyvine palveluineen. Kokonaisratkaisun tulee tukea perehdytyksen ja oppimisen suunnittelua, toteutusta, hallintaa, kohdentamista, seurantaa ja raportointia. Ratkaisun tulee mahdollistaa käyttäjä-, rooli-, tehtävä-, yksikkö- ja toimipaikkakohtaisten perehdytys- ja oppimispolkujen hallinta sekä sisältöjen kohdentaminen eri käyttäjäryhmille. Hankintaan sisältyvät perehdytysjärjestelmän ja oppimisjärjestelmän käyttöoikeudet jatkuvana SaaS-palveluna, käyttöönotto, määrittely ja konfigurointi, tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä määritellyt integraatiot, testaus, pilotointi, koulutukset, dokumentaatio, ylläpito, tuki, versiopäivitykset, palvelunhallinta, jatkuvuuden varmistaminen sekä palvelun päättämiseen ja tietojen siirtämiseen liittyvät exit-palvelut tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä määritellyssä laajuudessa. Hankintaan sisältyy käyttöönottoprojekti, joka kattaa vähintään projektinhallinnan, ratkaisun määrittelyn ja konfiguroinnin, tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä määritellyt integraatiot ja tietojen siirrot, testauksen, pilotoinnin, koulutukset, dokumentaation, tuotantokäyttöön siirtymisen sekä siirtymisen jatkuvaan palveluun. Käyttöönottoprojekti käynnistetään hankintasopimuksen allekirjoittamisen jälkeen. Hankintayksikön tavoitteena on, että kokonaisratkaisu otetaan tuotantokäyttöön 1.5.2027. Tarjoajan tulee esittää tarjouksessaan alustava käyttöönottosuunnitelma ja aikataulu tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä määritellyllä tavalla. Tarjoajan tulee ottaa suunnitelmassaan huomioon tuotantokäyttöä edeltävät määrittely-, konfigurointi-, integraatio-, tietojen siirto-, testaus-, pilotointi-, koulutus- ja hyväksymistehtävät. Tuotantokäyttö voidaan aloittaa, kun tarjouspyynnössä, hankintasopimuksessa ja niiden liitteissä määritellyt tuotantokäytön aloittamisen edellytykset ovat täyttyneet ja hankintayksikkö on hyväksynyt kokonaisratkaisun tuotantokäyttöön. Käyttöönottoprojektin tarkempi sisältö, vaiheistus, vastuut, tuotokset ja hyväksymismenettely määritellään tarjouspyynnössä, hankintasopimusluonnoksessa ja niiden liitteissä. Hankinnan kustannusrakenne ja vertailuhinta muodostetaan tarjouspyynnön hintaliitteen mukaisesti. Tarjoajan tulee hinnoitella kaikki kokonaisratkaisun toteuttamiseksi tarvittavat pakolliset kertaluonteiset ja jatkuvat kustannukset hintaliitteessä määritellyllä tavalla. Koulutuskalenteri sekä tavoite- ja kehityskeskustelujen hallinta eivät kuulu hankinnan kohteeseen. Tarjottavan kokonaisratkaisun tulee olla valmis ja tuotantokäytössä oleva SaaS-palvelu tai muu vastaava jatkuvana palveluna toimitettava ratkaisu. Hankinnan kohteena ei ole laaja asiakaskohtainen ohjelmistokehitysprojekti. Ratkaisun hankintayksikkökohtainen konfigurointi, tarjouspyynnössä määritellyt integraatiot sekä käyttöönottoon ja tietojen siirtämiseen liittyvät työt ovat kuitenkin sallittuja tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä määritellyssä laajuudessa. Hankintasopimus tulee voimaan, kun molemmat sopijapuolet ovat allekirjoittaneet sen. Käyttöönottoprojekti toteutetaan sopimuksen voimaantulon jälkeen ennen jatkuvan palvelun tuotantokäytön aloittamista sekä tarvittavilta osin tuotantokäytön aloittamisen jälkeen. Jatkuvan palvelun määräaikainen sopimuskausi on kaksi (2) vuotta ajalla 1.5.2027–30.4.2029. Hankintayksiköllä on oikeus jatkaa sopimusta kahdella yhden (1) vuoden optiokaudella. Ensimmäinen optiokausi on 1.5.2029–30.4.2030 ja toinen optiokausi 1.5.2030–30.4.2031. Optiokausien käyttäminen on hankintayksikön oikeus, ei velvollisuus, ja kummankin optiokauden käyttöönotosta päätetään erikseen. Hankintaa ei jaeta osa-alueisiin. Kilpailutuksen perusteella valitaan yksi (1) palveluntuottaja vastaamaan perehdytysjärjestelmän ja oppimisjärjestelmän muodostaman kokonaisratkaisun sekä siihen liittyvien käyttöönotto-, integraatio-, ylläpito-, tuki- ja muiden palvelujen toimittamisesta. Tarjottavaa kokonaisratkaisua ja palvelua koskevat toiminnalliset, tekniset ja laadulliset vaatimukset asetetaan tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä ehdottomiksi vähimmäisvaatimuksiksi. Tarjousvertailuun hyväksytään vain tarjoukset, jotka täyttävät kaikki asetetut vähimmäisvaatimukset.

sections.label: 사업 내용
sections.text: Διακήρυξη αριθ. 10/2025 Ηλεκτρονικού, Ανοικτού, Διεθνούς Διαγωνισμού για την παροχή υπηρεσιών με τίτλο Είδος Α': «Συντήρηση του Συστήματος Εθνικής Ενιαίας Ναυτιλιακής Θυρίδας» και Είδος Β': «Συντήρηση / Τεχνική υποστήριξη του υφιστάμενου συστήματος παρακτίου δικτύου AIS» συνολικής προϋπολογισθείσας αξίας τριακοσίων χιλιάδων ευρώ #399.999,97€# (συμπεριλαμβανομένων δικαιωμάτων προαίρεσης, Φ.Π.Α. και λοιπών κρατήσεων), με κριτήριο κατακύρωσης την πλέον συμφέρουσα από οικονομική άποψη προσφορά αποκλειστικά βάσει τιμής. Συστημικοί αριθμοί : - 386575- και -386676-

sections.label: 세부 사업 내용
sections.text: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η «Συντήρηση και Τεχνική υποστήριξη των ένδεκα (11) σταθμών βάσης, των εκατόν έξι (106) δεκτών του υφιστάμενου Αυτόματου Συστήματος Αναγνώρισης Πλοίων (Automatic Identification System - AIS), μετά των παρελκομένων τους, όπως αποτυπώνονται στον Πίνακα του Άρθρου 2 της Σύμβασης Τ03/2019 ΥΝΑΝΠ/ΓΔΟΥ/ΔΙΠΕΑ 2ο (Κωδικός ΑΔΑΜ: 19SYMV004968106). Οι εν λόγω συσκευές είναι εγκατεστημένες και λειτουργούν σε ενενήντα τρία (93) σημεία (κτίρια των λιμενικών Αρχών/Υπηρεσιών του Λ.Σ-ΕΛ.ΑΚΤ.) ανά την επικράτεια, όπως αυτά αποτυπώνονται στο Προσάρτημα του παρόντος. Σε είκοσι τέσσερα (24) εκ των ανωτέρω ενενήντα τριών (93) σημείων είναι εγκαταστημένες δύο (02) συσκευές AIS για λόγους εφεδρικότητας και υψηλής διαθεσιμότητας. Σε κάθε σημείο εγκατάστασης, ο σταθμός βάσης AIS συνδέεται τοπικά με έναν υφιστάμενο ηλεκτρονικό υπολογιστή, στον οποίο έχει εγκατασταθεί λογισμικό απεικόνισης των στόχων που λαμβάνει η συσκευή AIS επί χάρτη. Οι προς παροχή υπηρεσίες κατατάσσονται στον ακόλουθο κωδικό του Κοινού Λεξιλογίου δημοσίων συμβάσεων (CPV): 72267100-0 «Συντήρηση λογισμικού τεχνολογίας των πληροφοριών» Η συνολική προϋπολογισθείσα αξία της σύμβασης ανέρχεται στο ποσό των εκατόν ενενήντα εννέα χιλιάδων εκατόν ενενήντα εννέα ευρώ και ενενήντα οκτώ λεπτά του ευρώ #199.999,97€#, (συμπεριλαμβανομένων Φ.Π.Α. 24% και νομίμων κρατήσεων), (εκτιμώμενη αξία χωρίς Φ.Π.Α. #161.290,30€#, Φ.Π.Α.: #38.709,67€#). Ο χρόνος παροχής υπηρεσιών (εργασίες συντήρησης) θα είναι εντός τριάντα έξι (36) μηνών και θα ξεκινούν: • την 28-10-2026, σε περίπτωση που η Σύμβαση υπογραφεί σε προγενέστερο χρόνο της 28-10-2026. • την επομένη της υπογραφής της Σύμβασης, στην περίπτωση που αυτή υπογραφεί σε χρόνο μεταγενέστερο της 28-10-2026. Ως τόπος παροχής των υπηρεσιών ορίζεται η έδρα του Αρχηγείου Λ.Σ. –ΕΛ.ΑΚΤ. (Ακτή Βασιλειάδη, Πύλη Ε1, Λιμένας Πειραιά, Τ.Κ. 18510 [κωδικός NUTS: EL307 (Πειραιάς)]. Αναλυτική περιγραφή του φυσικού αντικειμένου της σύμβασης, δίδεται στο Παράρτημα Δ΄ - Τεχνικές Προδιαγραφές της παρούσας διακήρυξης για το Είδος Β’. Προσφορές υποβάλλονται για το σύνολο των παρεχόμενων υπηρεσιών ανά Είδος, όπως αυτές περιγράφονται αναλυτικά στο Παράρτημα Δ΄- Τεχνικές Προδιαγραφές. Η σύμβαση θα ανατεθεί με το κριτήριο της πλέον συμφέρουσας από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, αποκλειστικά βάσει τιμής. Αναλυτικές πληροφορίες παρέχονται και στον μοναδικό url https://nepps-search.eprocurement.gov.gr/actSearch/resources/search/386676 το οποίο παρέχει απευθείας πρόσβαση σε στοιχεία και έγγραφα της Δημόσιας Σύμβασης της ηλεκτρονικής διαδικασίας με ΑΑ 386676 στο ΕΣΗΔΗΣ.

notices.title: Romania – Programming services of application software – Servicii soluție informatică integrată în cadrul Proiectului ”Platforma de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agenția Națională Anti-Doping"

sections.label: 사업 내용
sections.text: Achizitia serviciilor de dezvoltare si implementare a Platformei de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agentia Nationala Anti-Doping, precum si a produselor hardware, a licentelor software si a solutiilor de securitate cibernetica necesare functionarii acesteia, in cadrul proiectului cod SMIS 342867. Prin prestarea serviciilor solicitate, autoritatea contractanta urmareste digitalizarea serviciilor publice furnizate de ANAD la un grad de sofisticare 4, care sa asigure o interactiune digitala avansata intre ANAD si beneficiarii serviciilor publice furnizate de aceasta. Autoritatea contractanta va raspunde in mod clar si complet tuturor solicitarilor de clarificare/informatiilor suplimentare in a 11-a zi inainte de termenul limita stabilit pentru depunerea ofertelor. Numarul de zile pana la care se pot solicita clarificari inainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor: 20 zile. ANAD dorește să achiziționeze servicii soluție informatică integrată (pachet complet pentru implementarea soluției informatice de digitalizare a serviciilor publice ANAD , hardware, licente, servicii dezvoltare, Securitate cibernetică, instruire).Achiziția este planificată în cadrul proiectului „Platforma de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agenția Națională Anti-Doping”, Cod SMIS 342867, finanțat prin Programul Creștere Inteligentă, Digitalizare și Instrumente Financiare 2021–2027 (PoCIDIF). În contextul accelerării transformării digitale la nivel european și național, precum și al creșterii cerințelor de eficiență operațională, ANAD inițiază un proiect amplu de digitalizare a serviciilor publice oferite, intitulat „Platforma de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agenția Națională Anti-Doping”. Necesitatea proiectului este determinată de limitele infrastructurii informatice actuale și de absența unui cadru digital integrat pentru interacțiunea cu beneficiarii serviciilor anti-doping. Prin realizarea acestui proiect, ANAD își propune să devină un model de bune practici în administrarea publică, oferind servicii eficiente și moderne care să răspundă nevoilor actuale și viitoare ale funcționarilor publici și cetățenilor. Modernizarea sistemului informatic va permite o gestionare internă mai eficientă, va facilita accesul la servicii digitale și va asigura un nivel înalt de securitate și conformitate.

sections.label: 세부 사업 내용
sections.text: Achizitia are ca obiect proiectarea, dezvoltarea, implementarea si punerea in functiune a Platformei de Servicii Publice Digitale a ANAD, solutie software cu caracter unitar si interdependent, compusa din module care comunica intre ele in mod direct, in timp real, cu o abordare unica inclusiv pentru analiza, dezvoltare, testare, implementare, instruire si suport tehnic post-implementare. Urmatoarele obiective specifice vor fi urmarite prin aceasta achizitie: • analiza si proiectarea sistemului informatic, cu documentarea arhitecturii tehnice si functionale; • dezvoltarea, configurarea si integrarea modulelor software, cu fluxuri de lucru electronice si gestiune electronica a documentelor, inclusiv workflow-uri pentru operatii asupra documentelor (semnare, aprobare, alocare); • dezvoltarea portalului public si a registraturii electronice, precum si a unei aplicatii mobile; • implementarea unui asistent virtual (chatbot) și a componentelor de inteligență artificială/învățare automată, cu suport pentru limba română, în conformitate cu cerințele detaliate în Caietul de sarcini (cap. 2.2.9, 2.4.1 și cerințele modulelor); • furnizarea, livrarea, instalarea și configurarea echipamentelor hardware prevăzute în Caietul de sarcini, cap. 2.7.4 (CHW-1 – CHW-10: server de infrastructură locală, laptopuri, periferice, monitoare, tablete, imprimante mobile, display interactiv, scaner de documente, centrală telefonică IP și terminale IP) și a licențelor software aferente; stațiile de lucru desktop, imprimantele laser, switch-urile și UPS-urile nu fac obiectul achiziției; • configurarea si operationalizarea infrastructurii de tip cloud privat/guvernamental in care este gazduita solutia; • implementarea solutiilor si serviciilor de securitate cibernetica, inclusiv servicii gestionate de tip MDR/SOC prestate din Uniunea Europeana; • interoperabilitatea cu alte sisteme informatice ale institutiilor care beneficiaza de serviciile ANAD si migrarea datelor istorice; • testarea, instruirea personalului autoritatii contractante, receptia si punerea in functiune a solutiei; • asigurarea serviciilor de garantie, suport tehnic si mentenanta post-implementare. Cerintele minime obligatorii, specificatiile tehnice si functionale, livrabilele si termenele sunt detaliate in Caietul de sarcini, parte integranta a documentatiei de atribuire.

sections.label: 참가·선정 기준
sections.text: Cerinta nr. 1 - Cifra medie anuala de afaceri Cifra medie anuala de afaceri a operatorului economic din ultimele 3 (trei) exercitii financiare incheiate (2023, 2024, 2025) va fi de cel putin dublul valorii estimate a contractului fara TVA, respectiv de cel putin 46266743,84 lei. Nivelul minim solicitat este stabilit cu respectarea plafonului prevazut la art. 175 alin. (2) din Legea nr. 98/2016 si este proportional cu complexitatea, durata (24 de luni) si mecanismul de plata etapizat al contractului. Echivalenta lei/alta valuta se va realiza la cursul mediu anual comunicat de Banca Nationala a Romaniei pentru fiecare exercitiu financiar in parte. Modalitatea de indeplinire: Se va completa DUAE. Ofertantul clasat pe locul 1 in clasamentul intocmit la finalizarea evaluarii ofertelor va prezenta bilanturile contabile sau extrasele de bilant aferente exercitiilor financiare 2023, 2024 si 2025, inregistrate la organele competente, rapoarte de audit financiar sau orice alte documente echivalente considerate edificatoare de autoritatea contractanta. Capacitatea economica si financiara poate fi sustinuta de un tert susținător, in conditiile art. 182 din Legea nr. 98/2016. In acest caz se prezinta DUAE completat de tertul susținător, angajamentul ferm al acestuia, precum si documentele transmise ofertantului de catre tert din care rezulta modul efectiv de sustinere. | Pentru contractele de achizitie de servicii: executarea de servicii de tipul specificat. Operatorul economic va face dovada că, în ultimii 3 (trei) ani, calculați până la data-limită de depunere a ofertelor, a prestat și finalizat ori are în execuție servicii similare sau superioare din punct de vedere al complexității, în valoare cumulată de cel puțin 11.566.685,96 lei fără TVA, prin maximum 5 (cinci) contracte. Prin servicii similare se înțeleg servicii de dezvoltare și/sau implementare ori extindere a unor sisteme informatice integrate, formate din mai multe module/componente software integrate, indiferent de natura publică sau privată a beneficiarului. Cu titlu exemplificativ, și fără ca acestea să fie cerințe cumulative, astfel de sisteme pot include: fluxuri de lucru electronice, gestiune electronică a documentelor, componente găzduite în cloud, componente de analiză automată a datelor sau de inteligență artificială. În cazul contractelor aflate în execuție, se ia în considerare doar partea de servicii prestată și recepționată până la data-limită de depunere a ofertelor. Modalitatea de îndeplinire: se va completa D.U.A.E. și se va prezenta lista principalelor servicii prestate, însoțită, pentru fiecare contract invocat, de: • denumirea și datele de contact ale beneficiarului; • obiectul contractului și valoarea acestuia (în lei și echivalent EUR); • perioada de derulare și stadiul (finalizat/în execuție); . recomandare, certificat de buna executie sau document echivalent emis de beneficiar, care sa confirme prestarea serviciilor si nivelul de calitate al acestora. Nota: prestarile de servicii se confirma prin prezentarea unor certificate/documente (fara a se limita la): contracte sau copii ale unor parti relevante ale contractelor pe care le-au indeplinit, certificate de predare-primire, recomandari, procese-verbale de receptie, certificari de buna executie, certificate constatatoare, emise sau contrasemnate de o autoritate ori de catre clientul privat beneficiar. In cazul contractelor aflate in derulare se va lua in considerare numai partea de servicii prestata si receptionata pana la data limita de depunere a ofertelor. Capacitatea tehnica si/sau profesionala poate fi sustinuta in conditiile art. 182 din Legea nr. 98/2016, prin prezentarea DUAE completat de tertul susținător, a angajamentului ferm al acestuia din care rezulta modul efectiv de sustinere, precum si a documentelor transmise ofertantului de catre tertul susținător. | Ofertantul va preciza in DUAE si in propunerea tehnica partea/partile din contract pe care intentioneaza sa le subcontracteze, precum si subcontractantii propusi, cu indicarea datelor de identificare si a procentului/valorii aferente. Modalitatea de indeplinire: Se va completa cate un DUAE distinct de catre fiecare subcontractant declarat, insotit de acordul/acordurile de subcontractare. Ofertantul clasat pe locul 1 va prezenta documentele justificative aferente subcontractantilor propusi, in aceeasi masura ca pentru contractant, in ceea ce priveste motivele de excludere. Autoritatea contractanta poate solicita inlocuirea unui subcontractant care se încadrează in motivele de excludere, in conditiile art. 170-171 si art. 218-221 din Legea nr. 98/2016 | Operatorul economic va prezenta certificarea ISO 9001 – Sistem de management al calității (sau certificat echivalent ori alte probe privind măsuri echivalente de asigurare a calității), valabilă la data prezentării documentului, emisă de un organism de certificare acreditat de un organism național de acreditare semnatar al EA-MLA sau de un organism similar recunoscut internațional. Domeniul de certificare trebuie să acopere activitățile care fac obiectul prezentului contract. Modalitatea de îndeplinire: Se va completa DUAE. La solicitarea Autorității Contractante, ofertantul clasat pe locul 1 va prezenta copia certificatului valabil, însoțită, după caz, de declarația organismului de certificare privind valabilitatea acestuia. În cazul unei asocieri, cerința va fi îndeplinită de fiecare membru al asocierii pentru partea de servicii pe care o va presta. Autoritatea contractantă acceptă certificate echivalente emise de organisme stabilite în alte state membre, precum și alte probe privind măsuri echivalente de asigurare a calității, în condițiile art. 199 din Legea nr. 98/2016. | NU | Informatii si formalitati necesare pentru evaluarea respectarii cerintelor mentionate: Se va prezenta dovada unei forme de inregistrare in conditiile legii din tara de rezidenta, care sa confirme ca ofertantul nu se afla in niciuna din situațiile de anulare a constituirii sale, precum si faptul ca are capacitatea profesionala de a realiza activitatile care fac obiectul contractului, respectiv ca obiectul de activitate include serviciile care fac obiectul prezentei achizitii. Nota: documentul va fi prezentat, in orice forma, semnat cu semnătura electronica extinsa bazata pe un certificat calificat, conform Legii nr. 214/2024 privind semnătura electronica. Informatiile din documentul prezentat trebuie sa fie reale/valide la data prezentarii acestuia. Pentru persoane juridice/fizice straine: in cazul ofertantilor de alta nationalitate decat cea romana, documentele mentionate vor fi transmise in limba de origine, însoțite de o traducere autorizata a acestora in limba romana. Documente edificatoare privind obiectul de activitate al operatorului economic (conform prevederilor art. 173 din Legea nr. 98/2016, cu modificarile si completarile ulterioare). Modalitatea de indeplinire: Se va completa DUAE, urmand ca documentul justificativ (certificat ONRC pentru operatorii economici romani, respectiv documentul echivalent emis in tara de rezidenta pentru ofertantii straini) sa fie prezentat la solicitarea autoritatii contractante de catre ofertantul clasat pe locul 1 in clasamentul intocmit la finalizarea evaluarii ofertelor. Documentele vor fi prezentate in traducere autorizata in limba romana. Justificare: In conformitate cu dispozitiile art. 173 din Legea nr. 98/2016, operatorul economic va prezenta documente relevante care sa dovedeasca forma de inregistrare si, dupa caz, de atestare ori apartenenta din punct de vedere profesional, in conformitate cu cerintele legale din tara in care este stabilit operatorul economic, astfel incat Autoritatea contractanta sa se asigure ca un ofertant are capacitatea juridica pentru a executa contractul de achizitie publica care urmeaza sa fie atribuit. Declaratia pe propria raspundere privind beneficiarul real Declaratie privind neincadrarea in situatiile prevazute la art. 5k din Regulamentul (UE) 2022/576.

sections.label: 사업 내용
sections.text: 21. Przedmiotem zamówienia jest dostawa i wdrożenie systemu przeznaczonego do kompleksowej obsługi kuratorskiej służby sądowej wraz z Portalem (dalej jako System) na potrzeby sądów apelacji gdańskiej, tj.: - okręg toruński (zamówienie podstawowe): 1) Sąd Okręgowy w Toruniu; 2) Sąd Rejonowy w Brodnicy; 3) Sąd Rejonowy w Grudziądzu; 4) Sąd Rejonowy w Toruniu; 5) Sąd Rejonowy w Chełmnie (sąd funkcjonalny); 6) Sąd Rejonowy w Golubiu-Dobrzyniu (sąd funkcjonalny); 7) Sąd Rejonowy w Wąbrzeźnie (sąd funkcjonalny); - okręg gdański (zamówienie podstawowe): 1) Sąd Okręgowy w Gdańsku; 2) Sąd Rejonowy Gdańsk-Północ w Gdańsku; 3) Sąd Rejonowy w Sopocie (sąd funkcjonalny); 4) Sąd Rejonowy w Kościerzynie (sąd funkcjonalny); 5) Sąd Rejonowy w Malborku; 6) Sąd Rejonowy w Starogardzie Gdańskim. 2. Przedmiot zamówienia obejmuje w szczególności: 1) dostawę Systemu i jego wdrożenie poprzez zdalną instalację i skonfigurowanie zakupionych modułów oraz dokonanie migracji danych z obecnie eksploatowanych w sądach apelacji gdańskiej systemów ewidencyjnych ZKSS do Systemu; 2) udzielenie otwartej, niewyłącznej, bezterminowej licencji bez limitu ilości stanowisk na opisane w OPZ moduły Systemu; 3) przeprowadzenie szkoleń z obsługi Systemu, zgodnie z wymaganiami określonymi w OPZ oraz w umowie; 4) świadczenie usługi opieki informatycznej dotyczącej Systemu, przez okres 12 miesięcy od dnia zakończenia rozruchu Systemu, potwierdzonego podpisaniem protokołu końcowego. 3. Szczegółowo zakres oraz opis przedmiotu zamówienia określony został Opisie przedmiotu zamówienia (OPZ) stanowiącym załącznik nr 1 do OFERTY. 4. Szczegółowe warunki realizacji przedmiotu zamówienia zawarte zostały we wzorze umowy stanowiącym załącznik nr 5 do SWZ.

sections.label: 참가·선정 기준
sections.text: Eignungskriterium 2.1 - Referenzen Zum Nachweis der technischen und beruflichen Leistungsfähigkeit reichen Sie bitte mittels der Vorlage Referenzen mindestens zwei (maximal 4) geeigneten Referenzen in Bezug zur gegenständlichen Leistung ein. Die Leistungsbereiche umfassen dabei folgende technischen Schwerpunkte: Bereitstellung, Überwachung, den Betrieb einer Multi-Cloud (Public, Private, Hybrid) und Unterstützungsleistungen unter Berücksichtigung der jeweils relevanten Aspekte der Informationssicherheit und des Daten- und Geheimschutzes, sowie der Multi- Cloudmanagementplattform • Incidentmanagement/ 1-st bis 3rd Level Support Management • Problemmanagement • Weiterentwicklung bestehender Services • Patch-/ Releasemanagement der Infrastruktur (Cloudplattform, Multi- Cloudmanagementplattform, Virtualisierung) • Dokumentation • Kontingent und Kapazitätsmanagement • Backup, Desaster Recovery • Funktionstests Technologien/Werkzeugen/Methoden: REST API, SwaggerUI, Elastic Stack, Kubernetes, Docker oder Podman, Ansible, git, Jenkins, GitOps, Terraform, Puppet, Helm, React, CI/CD, Spring, Spring-Boot, JEE Stellen Sie Ihre Leistungsfähigkeit für den Auftragsgegenstand und Ihre hierfür relevanten Erfahrungen anhand der Referenzen dar. Im Falle von Bietergemeinschaften und Bietern, die andere Unternehmen im Rahmen der Eignungsleihe einbinden ist im Vordruck Referenzen im Feld "Referenz des Bewerbers / Bieters" der Leistungserbringer der Referenz, d.h. das betroffene Mitglied der Bietergemeinschaft bzw. das eignungsverleihende Unternehmen, anzugeben. Nutzen Sie die Vorlage Referenzen, soweit erforderlich, bitte mehrfach. Zu den Referenzen sind insbesondere folgende Angaben zu machen:  Beschreibung der ausgeführten Leistungen,  Wert des Auftrages in Euro, bezogen auf den maßgeblichen Referenzeitraum,  Zeitraum der Leistungserbringung,  Angabe der zuständigen Kontaktstelle bei der Auftraggeberin der Referenz mit Anschrift und Kontaktdaten.  Darüber hinaus gelten die folgenden Mindestanforderungen an die benannten Referenzen: a) Die Referenzen müssen mindestens einen Auftrag eines öffentlichen Auftraggebers im Sinne von § 99 GWB umfassen; b) Der Auftragsgegenstand umfasst im Bereich der öffentlichen Verwaltung auf Bundesebene die Bereitstellung, Überwachung, den Betrieb einer Multi-Cloud (Public, Private, Hybrid) und Unterstützungsleistungen unter Berücksichtigung der jeweils relevanten Aspekte der Informationssicherheit und des Daten- und Geheimschutzes c) Der Auftragsgegenstand umfasst folgende technische Schwerpunkte: • Security- Appliances und - Softwarelösungen verschiedener Hersteller (z. Bsp. Genua, F5, Checkpoint) • • Storage Technologien (z.Bsp NetApp, Hitachi) • VMware Virtualisierungs- und Cloud Technologien • Linux- Betriebssysteme der Distribution Red Hat Enterprise Linux und deren Managementsysteme und -anwendungen • Microsoft- Betriebssysteme ab Windows 2019 Server und darauf basierender Standard- und OpenSource- Anwendungen sowie entsprechender Managementsysteme und - tools • Technologien/Werkzeugen/Methoden: REST API, SwaggerUI, Elastic Stack, Kubernetes, Docker oder Podman, Ansible, git, Jenkins, GitOps, Terraform, Puppet, Helm, React, CI/CD, Spring, Spring-Boot, JEE • Kontingentmanagement • Implementierung von Sicherheitsmaßnahmen gemäß den Anforderungen in der öffentlichen Verwaltung, um Daten und Anwendungen zu schützen d) Die Referenz darf nicht älter als drei Jahre sein (maßgeblich ist das Datum der letzten Leistungserbringung - gerechnet bis zum Datum der Auftragsbekanntmachung); e) Die Referenz hat eine Mindestlaufzeit von 18 Monaten, etwaige Unterbrechungen der Leistungserbringung zählen nicht zur Mindestlaufzeit (maßgeblich ist die bis zum bis zum Datum der Auftragsbekanntmachung erreichte Laufzeit); f) Der innerhalb der Referenz vom Unternehmen geleistete Umfang im Bereich der öffentlichen Verwaltung auf Bundes- und/oder Landesebene umfasst jeweils mindestens 1.600 PT/Jahr oder der Wert des Auftrags der jeweiligen Referenz entspricht mindestens 1.600.000 EUR/Jahr (netto). Sofern es sich um eine Referenz handelt, die noch nicht abgeschlossen wurde, ist der bisher erreichte Leistungsstand anzugeben. Noch nicht realisierte Leistungsstände können nicht berücksichtigt werden. Es sind hier mindestens zwei Referenzen gefordert. Es ist Ihnen unbenommen, weitere Referenzen (maximal 4) zu benennen. Da das Austauschen einer fehlerhaften Referenz durch eine nach Fristende nachgereichte bedingungsgemäße Referenz nicht möglich ist und in den entsprechenden Fällen den Ausschluss des Bieters nach sich zieht, empfiehlt die Vergabestelle des ITZBund, eine Liste von weiteren als bedingungsgemäß betrachteten Referenzen einzureichen. Das ITZBund behält sich vor, die angegebenen Referenzen zu verifizieren. Angaben, die einer Nachprüfung nicht standhalten, können zum Ausschluss vom Vergabeverfahren führen. Der Cloud Entwickler - Senior muss die allgemeinen Anforderungen gemäß Kapitel 4.3 der Leistungsbeschreibung sowie die folgenden fachlichen Anforderungen erfüllen: a) Berufs- und Projekterfahrung: o mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung als IT-Architekturberater*in oder IT-Migrationsarchitekt*in oder o mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT-Architekturberatung in IT-Konsolidierungsprojekten oder IT-Projekten mit Migrationsvorhaben oder o mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in dem Bereich "Informationssicherheit" oder o mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in dem Bereich "Servicebetrieb" in Konzeption und Entwicklung von Produkten und Services oder o mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in dem Bereich "technischer und fachlicher Applikationsbetrieb" b) Praktische Erfahrungen in folgenden Bereichen: o Erhebung und Analyse von Informationen und Daten für die Koordination und Umsetzung von IT-Maßnahmen o Konzeption technischer Zielbilder auf Grundlage von Architekturvorgaben o Erstellung von Netzwerk- und Rollenkonzepten o Analyse von Ist-Zuständen und Zielarchitekturen in den Bereichen Netzwerk, Firewall und Web Application Firewall o Konzeption und Entwicklung von Produkten und Services sowie in agilen Arbeitsweisen o Anwendung der OBASHI-Methode o Informationssicherheit nach IT-Grundschutz des BSI und praktische Umsetzung von BSI Standards o Umsetzung des BSI Standards NET.1.1 Netzarchitektur und -design in IT-Netzwerkarchitekturen c) Praktische Kenntnisse in folgenden Tools / Technologien: o Softwarearchitektur und Dokumentation mit Arc42 o Tools im Cloudumfeld wie z.B. Puppet, Ansible, Terraform, GitLab, oder ähnliche o Tools mit Containertechnologie wie z.B. Kubernetes, Openshift, HELM oder ähnliche o Tools im Automatisierungsumfeld wie z.B. Ansible, Puppet, Terraform, Rest-API oder ähnliche o Tools in der 3-Tier-Technologie wie z.B. Apache, Tomcat, JBOSS, Oracle RAC, MS SQL oder ähnliche o Microsoft Project oder ähnliche Projektmanagement-Tools zur Planung, Steuerung und Überwachung von IT-Projekten Reichen Sie als Beleg für das Vorliegen der Anforderungen der technischen Leistungsfähigkeit die Eigenerklärung zur Anzahl der Fachkräfte mit der Anlage " Eigenerklärung Fachkräfte" ein. | Eignungkriterium 2.3.2 -Nachweis der technischen und beruflichen Leistungsfähigkeit (Qualitätsmanagementsystem) Zum Nachweis der technischen und beruflichen Leistungsfähigkeit reichen Sie bitte einen Nachweis über eine gültige Zertifizierung über ein beim Bieter bestehendes Qualitätsmanagementsystem gemäß ISO 9001 oder ein gleichwertiges Qualitätssicherungssystem ein. | Eignungkriterium 2.3.1 -Nachweis der technischen und beruflichen Leistungsfähigkeit (Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystem gemäß ISO 27001) Zum Nachweis der technischen und beruflichen Leistungsfähigkeit reichen Sie bitte einen Nachweis über eine gültige Zertifizierung über ein beim Bieter bestehendes Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystem gemäß ISO 27001 oder ein gleichwertiges Informationssicherheitssystem ein. | Eignungskriterium 1.1 Spezifischer jährlicher Mindestumsatz Zum Nachweis der wirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Leistungsfähigkeit ist der Gesamtumsatz/ Umsatz im Tätigkeitsbereich des Auftrags für die letzten drei Geschäftsjahre anzugeben. Der geforderte bereichsspezifische Netto-Mindestumsatz für jedes Geschäftsjahr beträgt 40.000.000 EUR (netto). Der Netto-Jahresumsatz ist dann bereichsspezifisch, wenn er sich auf die dargestellten Leistungsinhalte der Anlage "Leistungsbeschreibung" bezieht. Übersenden Sie bitte die ausgefüllte Anlage Eigenerklärung Umsatz, welche die jeweiligen Jahreswerte der letzten drei Geschäftsjahre vor Auftragsbekanntmachung belegt. Im Falle von Bietergemeinschaften werden die Umsätze der jeweiligen Bieterkonstellation addiert. Bei Vorliegen einer Bietergemeinschaft ist die Anlage Eigenerklärung Umsatz von dem bevollmächtigten Mitglied der Bietergemeinschaft für die jeweiligen Mitglieder der Bietergemeinschaft auszufüllen. Im Falle von Bietern, die andere Unternehmen im Rahmen der Eignungsleihe einbinden, ist der o.g. Mindestumsatz für die letzten drei Geschäftsjahre vom eignungsverleihenden Unternehmen anzugeben. Übersenden Sie bitte für jedes eignungsverleihendes Unternehmen die ausgefüllte Anlage Eigenerklärung Umsatz. Sofern Sie aus berechtigten Gründen die Unterlagen nicht beibringen können, teilen Sie diese Gründe der Vergabestelle des ITZBund mit und legen Sie einen anderen geeigneten Nachweis der wirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Leistungsfähigkeit vor. Die Vergabestelle entscheidet sodann nach pflichtgemäßem Ermessen über die Anerkennung des Alternativnachweises. Sofern Sie diesbezüglich unsicher sind, kontaktieren Sie die Vergabestelle unbedingt rechtzeitig vor Ablauf der Angebotsfrist in Form einer Bewerber-/Bieterfrage. Ein Nachfordern und Beibringen eines anderen (geeigneteren) Nachweises ist nach dem Angebotsschluss aus vergaberechtlichen Gründen nicht mehr möglich. Wird auf mehrere Lose geboten, müssen die Mindestumsätze kumulativ erklärt werden.

sections.label: 사업 내용
sections.text: The ICM 2.0 project consists of the implementation of a new automated pallet warehouse for the Fluxys Intervention Centre, ensuring reliable 24/7 material availability. The scope includes the design, supply, automation, software, system integration, implementation and supporting services, as well as a maintenance contract for the automated warehouse system, to ensure a high-availability and future-proof warehouse operation.

sections.label: 참가·선정 기준
sections.text: The candidate must have the necessary economic and financial standing to perform the contract. Proof of the candidate's economic and financial standing may be furnished by one or more of the following references: a) the presentation of financial statements or extracts from the financial statements (last three financial years), where publication of financial statements is required under the law of the country in which the economic operator is established. b) a statement of the economic operator's overall turnover of the last three financial years available, depending on the date on which the undertaking was set up or the economic operator started trading. | The candidate must have an average yearly turnover of at least EUR 4 million (average over the last 3 years). This criterion applies to the candidate as a whole, i.e. through the combined capacity of all members of the group in case of a group of economic operators. | In reference to financial statements to be provided, the following financial ratio’s shall be met: Average (last 3 years) of the current ratio (i.e. current assets divided by current liabilities) of the last three years must be above 1.0; Average (last 3 years) of the solvency ratio (i.e. equity divided by total assets) of the last three years must be above 20%. This criterion applies to each member of the group in case of a group of economic operators. Where the candidate does not itself meet the minimum economic and financial requirements and relies on the economic and financial capacity of another entity, including a parent company, holding company or other group company, the candidate must clearly identify that entity in its request to participate and submit the relevant financial information and supporting documents of that entity, including the financial statements or extracts from the financial statements for the last three financial years available and the relevant turnover information. The candidate must also demonstrate that the resources of that entity will effectively be available for the performance of the contract by submitting a binding written undertaking from that entity. Fluxys may require such entity to provide an additional parent company guarantee or equivalent binding guarantee limited to the economic and financial capacity relied upon by the candidate. Where the candidate relies on such economic and financial capacity, the candidate and the entity whose capacity is relied upon may be held jointly and severally liable towards Fluxys for the performance of the contract, insofar as the relied-upon capacity is concerned. | The candidate must also provide evidence of relevant professional risk indemnity insurance. The candidate must have the necessary technical and professional ability to perform the contract. Proof of the candidate's ability must be furnished by the following means (in case of a joint tender, the combined capacity of all members is considered). The relevant professional risk indemnity insurance must have a minimum coverage of EUR 1,25 million. | The candidate must demonstrate proven experience in the supply and implementation of comparable automated pallet warehouses by submitting at least three reference assignments completed during the past five years. For each reference, the candidate must provide at least the client name, contract period, location, scope of supply and services, capacity of the system, description of the automation solution, description of the WCS/WMS integration, role of the candidate, date of commissioning or handover, and client contact details. Minimum level required: at least three references must concern an automated pallet warehouse (AS/RS) with a minimum capacity of 3,000 pallet locations. Each reference must include WCS/WMS integration and must have been completed and put into operation to the satisfaction of the client. | The candidate must demonstrate that it has its own technical team, including both hardware technicians and software specialists, available for maintenance and interventions. The candidate must state the number of own employees per discipline, their qualifications or relevant experience, and their usual working location. Minimum level required: the candidate must have at least four own hardware technicians and at least four own software specialists available for maintenance and interventions in relation to automated warehouse systems. The candidate must clearly identify the relevant discipline and location of these resources. | Helpdesk and incident reporting point. The candidate must demonstrate that it has an operational helpdesk or hotline for reporting, registering, following up and closing incidents relating to the automated warehouse system. The candidate must describe the helpdesk organization, availability, escalation process, incident registration method and reporting process. Minimum level required: the candidate must have an operational incident reporting point that can receive, register and follow up incidents. | Language capabilities. The candidate must demonstrate that it has, or can provide, personnel with the language capabilities required for the performance of the contract, taking into account the required interaction with Fluxys operational and technical teams. Minimum level required: hardware technicians must be able to communicate in Dutch. Software specialists must be able to communicate in Dutch, French and/or English. | Continuity of services. The candidate must describe how continuity of the services will be ensured in the event of the departure, long-term absence or replacement of key personnel involved in the implementation, maintenance or support of the automated warehouse system. The candidate must provide an organizational chart and the CVs and relevant certificates of the key personnel proposed for the performance of the contract. Minimum level required: the candidate must have documented continuity measures, including back-up resources, knowledge transfer arrangements and replacement procedures for key personnel. | HSE policy and safety management. The candidate must demonstrate that it has appropriate HSE policies, procedures and safety management measures in place for the performance of comparable services. The candidate must provide details of its safety policy, safety performance indicators for similar assignments carried out during the last three years, including frequency rate, severity rate, incident rate and inspection rate, details of any recent safety awards, an index of safety procedures covering the scope of the contract, and either a draft safety management plan for the contract or a typical plan used on a similar recent contract. Minimum level required: the candidate must have a documented HSE policy and safety management approach applicable to the scope of the contract, including procedures for risk assessment, site safety organization, incident reporting and follow-up, and compliance with applicable European and Belgian HSE legislation. The candidate must also demonstrate that HSE-competent personnel are involved in the screening and approval of relevant installations, machinery, work equipment and dangerous products, where applicable.
